blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Food vocabulary is part of office life in London. Every day at work you talk about food. You have lunch meetings, client dinners, and quick coffees.

There are three meals in the day. Breakfast is the first meal. Lunch is usually light and fast. Dinner is later, around seven or eight. A full English is a traditional British breakfast with eggs and bread. Fish and chips is a classic London dinner.

When you order, you can be polite. Say "Could I have a coffee?" You can order a coffee "to go" or "takeaway." If you are not sure about the food, ask "Is this vegetarian?" In a restaurant, you tip about 10 to 12.5%.

items.q: How many meals are in the day, according to the text?
items.why: "There are three meals in the day." — breakfast, lunch e dinner.

items.q: What is lunch usually like?
items.why: "Lunch is usually light and fast."

items.q: What is a full English?
items.why: "A full English is a traditional British breakfast with eggs and bread."

items.q: The text suggests that food words are…
options: useful every day at the office
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que você fala de comida todo dia no trabalho, então essas palavras são úteis diariamente.

items.q: Why does the text teach the question "Is this vegetarian?"
options: Because it is the only polite question
Because everyone in London is vegetarian
Because it helps you when you are not sure about the food
items.why: Inferência: o texto ensina a pergunta para o caso de você não ter certeza sobre o prato.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falar sobre as refeições britânicas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I'm Sophie. Let me tell you about British meals. It's easy!

In the morning, we have breakfast. On a normal day, it is small — some bread, coffee, or tea. But on the weekend, we love a full English breakfast. It has eggs, and it is big and slow. It is my favourite.

At the office, lunch is quick. Many people eat a sandwich at their desk. I like to get a coffee "to go" and walk in the park. Lunch is light, because we work in the afternoon.

Dinner is later, around seven or eight. This is the big meal. Sometimes I cook at home, and sometimes I go out with friends. A classic London dinner is fish and chips. It is simple, and it is very good.

So remember: breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Three meals, three little words. Now you can talk about food in London!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: When does Sophie have a full English breakfast?
items.why: "But on the weekend, we love a full English breakfast."

items.q: What do many people eat for lunch at the office?
items.why: "Many people eat a sandwich at their desk."

items.q: What time is dinner?
items.why: "Dinner is later, around seven or eight."

items.q: Why is Sophie's lunch light?
options: Because she works in the afternoon
Because the office has no food
Because she has a big breakfast
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "Lunch is light, because we work in the afternoon."

items.q: How does Sophie feel about British meals?
options: She thinks they are simple and nice
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "It's easy!", chama o full English de favorito e diz que fish and chips é "simple" e "very good".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I have breakfast at seven in the morning." Breakfast is…
options: the first meal of the day
the last meal of the day
items.why: Breakfast = café da manhã, a primeira refeição do dia.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We have a quick ___ at noon before the meeting."
items.why: Lunch = almoço, a refeição do meio do dia ("at noon").

items.q: "We had dinner with the client at eight." Dinner is…
items.why: Dinner = jantar, a refeição da noite.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I like ___ and butter for breakfast."
items.why: Bread = pão, o que combina com manteiga ("butter") no café da manhã.

items.q: "A full English breakfast has eggs." Eggs are…
items.why: Eggs = ovos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que você usa para comer e pedir no dia a dia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can I have a coffee to go, please?" To go means…
items.why: To go (= takeaway) = para viagem, para levar.

items.q: "Could I have the fish and chips, please?" We use Could I have to…
items.why: "Could I have…" é a forma educada de pedir algo.

items.q: "Is this vegetarian?" A vegetarian dish has…
items.why: Vegetarian = vegetariano, prato sem carne.

items.q: "Let's grab a coffee before the meeting." To grab a coffee means to…
items.why: Grab a coffee = pegar um café rápido.

items.q: "For the main, I'll have the fish." On a menu, the main is…
options: the sweet dish at the end
items.why: Na ordem "starter, main, dessert", o main é o prato principal, o prato central.
